messages:
jessica: FYI customer reported sudden p99 jump from ~220ms to 900-1300ms for eu-west-1 calls, plus intermittent 401s. They say their client is hitting eu-west-1 endpoint.
ajay: Which customer and sample trace id? 401s + latency often points to token validation fallback or cross-region egress.
jessica: acme-inc. Sample traces: trace=tr_9a2b3c, tr_9a2b3d. I pasted a short header dump they captured.
jessica: ```
GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Request-Region: eu-west-1
--- response headers ---
x-serving-region: us-west-2
x-final-egress: global-egress-1
x-request-id: tr_9a2b3c
```
ben: whoa x-serving-region shows us-west-2. Customer said they pinned eu-west-1. Could be egress pool fallback or router incorrectly matching tenant region.
liam: Can we get the span timeline (sampling might have given us full trace). tracing-bot: attached trace tr_9a2b3c (span list): router->auth(v2)->egress-proxy->runtime->model. Longest delay is egress-proxy->runtime (600ms).
ajay: Can you reproduce from our side or with their token? If auth fails sometimes maybe our JWKS lookup is slow and we fall back to a global path that routes through us-west. Requesting curl from a eu VM to the customer's configured endpoint.
jessica: I asked customer for a repro command. They sent: 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
They say response has x-serving-region: us-west-2 about 30% of the time.
ben: Running traceroute from eu-egress-instance-12 to the model node in eu shows a detour when the latency spike happens. I collected a short traceroute:
```
traceroute to model-eu-1 (10.4.2.15), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  1.2 ms
 2  100.64.2.1  2.1 ms
 3  * * *
 4  52.95.110.10 (us-west-2-egress)  210.3 ms 
 5  10.4.2.15  210.5 ms
```
ben: see hop 4 — traffic is hitting us-west egress node. That explains the added 200ms and occasional 401 if auth caches are region-scoped.
liam: What changed recently? Any rollout touching egress weights or health-check windows? ops-bot: deploy: egress-routing: rollout v2 -> eu weight change 2026-03-12T08:22Z by infra-release (ticket INF-861).
ajay: Patch note says "increase global fallback weight to 100 for emergency routing" — that sounds suspicious. Can you grep config for acme-inc tenant?
ben: Found tenant policy: "prefer_local": true but our router will still route to global if local pool health < 1. One of eu nodes reported degraded health ~08:21 and global fallback took full traffic. The health event correlates with the infra rollout.
jessica: Customer on call now asking for ETA to fix. They are seeing auth errors during the spike window due to region-scoped JWKS TTL differences.
liam: Short-term mitigation: pin customer traffic to dedicated eu egress pool by setting tenant routing override -> prefer_local_for_token=true. I can push a safe flag. Long-term: router must check token-issuer region binding before fallback. I'll open runtime PR.
ajay: Steps to repro for SRE/Support playbook: 
1) From eu VM run: 
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://eu.api.redwood.example/v1/generate; sleep 0.2; done
```
2) capture response headers for x-serving-region and x-final-egress.
3) collect traceroute/tcpdump on eu-egress-instance-*.
4) match trace ids with tracing-bot.

Please add this to the support runbook.

ben: I pushed routing override for acme-inc -> prefer_local_for_token=true. Monitoring now.

ops-bot: config-change applied to tenant acme-inc by ben at 2026-03-12T09:02Z

tracing-bot: detected traces with tr_9a2b3c pattern showing egress hop to us-west reduced from 30% -> 2% after override.

jessica: Customer confirmed latency back to normal and 401s gone. They've accepted temporary workaround and want timeline for permanent fix.

liam: I'll schedule a patch to the router: verify token region binding before using global fallback (PR opened: git.redwood/infra/router#445). ETA 24h to canary, 72h to full rollout.

ajay: Create incident ticket and post-mortem please. Also note that rollout INF-861 should have included tenant-scoped rollout flag.

jessica: Filed INC-2026-789 in pagerduty and added customer notes. Sending customer summary and timeline now. :thumbsup:

ben: Adding recorded traceroute snippets and a small diag script to the support playbook. I'll also add a one-liner to detect if an egress pool degrades and notify infra immediately.

jessica: Thanks team — closing thread once postmortem link is attached.
